'''Domain Carr''' was a [[Domain]] among the [[Warrior caste]] of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]. Members of this Domain were [[Supreme Commander (Yuuzhan Vong rank)|Supreme Commander]] [[Malik Carr]], and [[Yomin Carr]].
